Recurve of the Dark Gods.d: Dark forces permeate the bow, forces with ancient origins that we still do not quite understand.

Reeds of Spontanea.d: Ever blossoming, ever vibrant, ever radiant as the mercurial shimmer of false hope.

Reinforced Myrmidon's Boots.d: Guard yourself while you guard others.

Rifle of the Corrupted Abomination.d: It took all of my might to bring down the abomination and rip the weapon from its cold dead hands.

Rigor Mortis.d: As strong as a fist clenched forever in anger. As cold as a corpse, dead for twenty days.

Rolling Thunder.d: I know they'll hear me coming. Subtlety is for people who have something to fear.

Sacrosanct.d: Ancient magic and divine blessings, forged in the fires of vengeance.

Sagacious Shoes.d: Some comfortable clothes from a dangerous land.

Salted Earth.d: Nothing shall remain when we finish with you. Your lineage, your future, all that will remain will be memories.

Savvy Swing.d: I've never seen a flail used like that before.

Scorpio Slasher.d: From what we can deduce, Scorpio was a sacred place to the Ancients warriors, and their Guardians still linger around the ruins.

Shard Of The Obelisk.d: This fragment of the Obelisk still hums and shakes in the presence of Azoth, as if threatening to shatter once more.

Shard of Reality.d: We have a tentative grasp on our reality, but what of the others?

Shard of a Memory.d: Despite all of the atrocities she has committed, Isabella was once human like us.

Signum Phalarae.d: A beacon of honor shining from earlier times.

Souldrain.d: Screams echo from each soul gathered.

Spearman's Gloves.d: Calloused hands fit naturally into such well used gloves.

Spectral Arson.d: A great dark fire once burned, ravaging all in its path.

Staff of Fiery Torment.d: The fires of hell burn hot and long.

Staff of Peerless Whispers.d: Succumb to the void and let yourself be free.

Stefna.d: Every Varangian Knight knows, when they that boisterous voice echo across the battlefield, it's time to rally behind Sir Halfdan.

Stormtear.d: A strike in the sky ripped it apart, revealing the Void beyond.

Teardrop.d: A tear shed for a soul lost.

The Big Stick.d: You may as well forgo speaking softly.

The Bright.d: One part of an exquisitely crafted armor set, distributed among the Varangian Knights' esteemed leaders. This piece was tailor-made for Kari the Subtle.

The Quartermaster.d: Hungry sailors often try to sneak into the stores for an extra biscuit. But the risk of losing a hand was deterence enough for most.

Tiger's Instinct.d: Glad I had a friend watching my back when that beast ambushed me from behind.

Voidsword.d: It was hidden away by the ancients as they feared its power. Do not hesitate to turn it upon them.

Wanderers Pants.d: Their wearer wandered the world, and these pants wandered the seas.

Wedding Tribute.d: This weapon was a gift for the bride to be. Instead it would be her undoing.

Whirling Matter.d: The great axe seems to form from nothing before returning to nothing.

Withering Gloves.d: These gloves have only ever been worn by those of an advancing age. As their new wearer, you feel it may not have been coincidental...

Ranger's Vision.d: They said he could see over the horizon, and shoot just as far.
